run_cli_interactive_shell: run the LiteLLM Proxy CLI interactive shell for managing the proxy server
run_cli_version: run the LiteLLM Proxy CLI version command to show CLI and server version info
run_cli_login: run the LiteLLM Proxy CLI login command to authenticate and store an API key
run_cli_models: run the LiteLLM Proxy CLI models command group to manage proxy models
run_cli_chat: run the LiteLLM Proxy CLI chat command group to chat with LLM models through the proxy
